records.title: GACC 2024 No. 72
records.scope: Malaysia-grown fresh durian (Durio zibethinus) is approved for import into China under GACC Announcement 2024 No. 72, subject to its requirements.
conditions: Orchards and packing houses require Malaysian review and GACC registration.
Apply orchard pest monitoring, integrated pest management and traceability.
Clean and grade fruit; follow protocol packaging and destination markings.
Provide the phytosanitary certificate, required declarations and import quarantine permit; use an authorized entry port.

records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2024年第72号
records.scopeZh: 根据海关总署公告2024年第72号，马来西亚种植的鲜食榴莲（Durio zibethinus）获准输华，须符合公告规定的要求。
conditionsZh: 果园和包装厂须经马来西亚主管部门审核，并在中国海关总署注册。
果园须实施有害生物监测、综合防治和溯源管理。
水果须经清洁、分级；包装和输华标识须符合议定书要求。
须提供植物检疫证书、规定的附加声明和进境动植物检疫许可证，并从指定口岸入境。

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 78
records.scope: Fresh Cocos nucifera grown in Malaysia.
conditions: Orchards and packing houses require Malaysian review and GACC registration.
Maintain pest monitoring, control records and traceability.
Follow packing, container sealing and pre-export inspection requirements.
records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2025年第78号
records.scopeZh: 马来西亚种植的鲜食椰子（Cocos nucifera）。
conditionsZh: 果园和包装厂须经马来西亚主管部门审核，并在中国海关总署注册。

records.title: GACC 2023 No. 107
records.scope: Fresh Persea americana grown in South Africa.
conditions: Orchards, packing houses and fumigation facilities require GACC registration.
Methyl bromide fumigation is required under this protocol; consult the source for exact parameters.
Obtain the phytosanitary certificate with required declarations and treatment details, and the Chinese import quarantine permit.
Use an authorized fruit entry port and comply with arrival inspection.
records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2023年第107号
records.scopeZh: 南非种植的鲜食鳄梨（Persea americana）。
conditionsZh: 果园、包装厂和熏蒸处理设施须在中国海关总署注册。
该议定书要求进行溴甲烷熏蒸处理；具体技术指标请查阅公告原文。
须取得植物检疫证书（含规定的附加声明和处理信息）以及中国的进境动植物检疫许可证。
须从允许进口水果的指定口岸入境，并接受入境检验检疫。

records.title: GACC 2026 No. 103
records.scope: Fresh chilli fruits grown and processed in Laos for human consumption. This record covers fresh fruit only.
conditions: Growing sites and packing houses require GACC registration.
Fresh chillies require fumigation followed by cold treatment under Lao supervision; consult the source for exact parameters.
Retain pest monitoring and control records for at least two years.
Provide the phytosanitary certificate, required declaration, treatment details and traceable packaging.
records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2026年第103号
records.scopeZh: 在老挝种植和加工、供人类食用的鲜辣椒果实。本记录只涵盖鲜果。
conditionsZh: 种植基地和包装厂须在中国海关总署注册。
鲜辣椒须在老挝主管部门监管下先熏蒸、再冷处理；具体技术指标请查阅公告原文。
有害生物监测和防治记录至少保存两年。
须提供植物检疫证书、规定的附加声明和处理信息，包装须可追溯。

records.scopeZh: 马来西亚种植的鲜食菠萝蜜（Artocarpus heterophyllus）。

records.title: GACC 2023 No. 143
records.scope: Fresh mango (Mangifera indica) from mango production areas of Laos is permitted under GACC Announcement 2023 No. 143.
records.scopeZh: 老挝芒果产区的鲜食芒果（Mangifera indica）依据海关总署公告2023年第143号获准进口。
conditions: Orchards, packing houses, cold stores and heat-treatment facilities must be reviewed by Laos and registered by GACC.
Vapour heat or hot-water treatment is required before export.
Cartons labelled in English with origin and registration numbers and marked for export to China.
Phytosanitary certificate with heat-treatment details and additional declaration; 2% sampling in the first two years.
conditionsZh: 果园、包装厂、冷库和热处理设施须经老方审核并由海关总署注册。
出口前须实施蒸热处理或热水处理。
包装箱须用英文标注产地和注册号，并标明“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须注明热处理信息并附加声明；前两年按2%抽样检查。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 247
records.scope: Fresh persimmon (Diospyros spp.) from Korean production areas is permitted under GACC Announcement 2025 No. 247.
records.scopeZh: 韩国柿子产区的鲜食柿子（Diospyros spp.）依据海关总署公告2025年第247号获准进口。
conditions: Orchards and packing houses must be registered by Korea and approved by China.
Orchards apply GAP/IPM with fortnightly pest monitoring from flowering to harvest.
Fruit is sorted, graded and cleaned with high-pressure air or water; cartons marked for export to China.
Phytosanitary certificate with additional declaration; import quarantine permit and approved entry ports.
conditionsZh: 果园和包装厂须由韩方注册并经中方批准。
果园实施良好农业规范和综合防治，自开花至采收每两周监测一次有害生物。
水果须经分拣、分级并用高压气枪或水清洁；包装箱须标注“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须附加声明；须办理进境动植物检疫许可证并从获准口岸进境。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 251
records.scope: Fresh jackfruit (Artocarpus heterophyllus) from Vietnamese production areas is permitted under GACC Announcement 2025 No. 251, effective 1 June 2026.
records.scopeZh: 越南菠萝蜜产区的鲜食菠萝蜜（Artocarpus heterophyllus）依据海关总署公告2025年第251号获准进口，自2026年6月1日起实施。
conditions: Orchards and packing houses must be audited by Vietnam and registered by China.
Orchards apply IPM and monitor mealybugs at least every 15 days from flowering to harvest; fruit is sorted and cleaned with high-pressure air or water.
Cartons and pallets marked for export to China; containers sealed.
Phytosanitary certificate with additional declaration; import quarantine permit and designated entry ports.
conditionsZh: 果园和包装厂须经越方审核并由中方批准注册。
果园实施综合防治，自开花至采收至少每15天监测一次粉蚧；水果须经挑选并用高压气枪或水清洁。
包装箱和托盘须标注“输往中华人民共和国”；集装箱须加封。
植物检疫证书须附加声明；须办理进境动植物检疫许可证并从指定口岸进境。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 72
records.scope: Fresh passion fruit (Passiflora edulis) from passion-fruit production areas of Vietnam is permitted under GACC Announcement 2025 No. 72.
records.scopeZh: 越南百香果产区的鲜食百香果（紫果西番莲，Passiflora edulis）依据海关总署公告2025年第72号获准进口。
conditions: Orchards and packing houses must be audited by Vietnam and registered by GACC.
Orchards apply integrated pest management; packing includes manual sorting to remove infested fruit.
Cartons show fruit name, origin and registration numbers and are marked for export to China.
Phytosanitary certificate with additional declaration; Vietnam samples 2% of each consignment (1% after one clean year).
conditionsZh: 果园和包装厂须经越方审核并由海关总署批准注册。
果园实施有害生物综合防治；包装时人工分拣剔除带虫病果。
包装箱标注水果名称、产地和注册号，并标明“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须附加声明；越方按每批2%抽样（一年无问题降为1%）。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2026 No. 52
records.scope: Fresh pomelo (Citrus maxima) from Vietnamese production areas is permitted under GACC Announcement 2026 No. 52 (the same announcement covers green, unripe limes).
records.scopeZh: 越南产区的鲜食柚子（Citrus maxima）依据海关总署公告2026年第52号获准进口（该公告同时涵盖未成熟的绿色莱檬）。
conditions: Orchards and packing houses must be audited by Vietnam and registered by China.
Pomelos must be bagged during growth; orchards monitor fruit flies, mealybugs, moths and fungi.
Fruit is hand-sorted and washed; cartons and pallets marked for export to China.
Phytosanitary certificate with additional declaration; 2% sampling with at least 30 fruit cut; import quarantine permit required.
conditionsZh: 果园和包装厂须经越方审核并由中方批准注册。
输华柚子应在生长周期套袋；果园须监测实蝇、粉蚧、蛾类和真菌。
水果须经人工挑选和清洗；包装箱和托盘须标注“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须附加声明；按2%抽样并剖果不少于30个；须办理进境动植物检疫许可证。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 186
records.scope: Fresh pear (Pyrus communis) from pear-growing areas of mainland Portugal (Azores and Madeira excluded) is permitted under GACC Announcement 2025 No. 186.
records.scopeZh: 葡萄牙大陆梨产区（不含亚速尔群岛和马德拉群岛）的鲜梨（Pyrus communis）依据海关总署公告2025年第186号获准进口。
conditions: Orchards, packing houses and cold-treatment facilities must be audited by Portugal and registered by GACC.
Pears from Mediterranean fruit fly areas require supervised cold treatment (e.g. 1.11°C for at least 14 days).
Ventilation openings screened (max 1.6 mm mesh); cartons and pallets marked for export to China.
Phytosanitary certificate with cold-treatment details and additional declaration; 2% sampling in the first two years.
conditionsZh: 果园、包装厂和冷处理设施须经葡方审核并由海关总署注册。
来自地中海实蝇发生区的梨须在官方监管下冷处理（如1.11℃持续至少14天）。
通风孔须加防虫网（孔径不超过1.6毫米）；包装箱和托盘须标注“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须注明冷处理信息并附加声明；前两年按2%抽样检查。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 229
records.scope: Fresh pomegranate (Punica granatum) from pomegranate production areas of Peru is permitted under GACC Announcement 2025 No. 229.
records.scopeZh: 秘鲁石榴产区的鲜食石榴（Punica granatum）依据海关总署公告2025年第229号获准进口。
conditions: Orchards, packing houses and cold-treatment facilities must be audited by Peru and registered by China.
Cold treatment before export or in transit: pulp at 1.11°C or below for 15 days, or 1.67°C or below for 17 days.
Cartons and pallets marked with origin, registration numbers and export-to-China wording.
Phytosanitary certificate with additional declaration; Peru samples 2% of each consignment.
conditionsZh: 果园、包装厂和冷处理设施须经秘方审核并由中方批准注册。
须在出口前或运输途中冷处理：果肉温度1.11℃或以下持续15天，或1.67℃或以下持续17天。
包装箱和托盘须标注产地、注册号及“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须附加声明；秘方按每批2%抽样检查。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC

records.title: GACC 2025 No. 71
records.scope: Chilli (Capsicum spp.) grown and processed in Vietnam for human consumption, including fresh chilli, is permitted under GACC Announcement 2025 No. 71.
records.scopeZh: 在越南种植和加工的食用辣椒（Capsicum spp.，含新鲜辣椒）依据海关总署公告2025年第71号获准进口。
conditions: Growing bases and packing houses must be audited by Vietnam and registered by GACC.
Fresh chilli requires methyl bromide fumigation followed by cold treatment under Vietnamese supervision.
Phytosanitary certificate must state plantation, packer and treatment details with the additional declaration.
Vietnam samples 2% of each lot before export (1% after one year without problems).
conditionsZh: 种植基地和包装厂须经越方审核并由海关总署批准注册。
新鲜辣椒须在越方监管下先行溴甲烷熏蒸，再实施冷处理。
植物检疫证书须注明种植基地、包装厂和处理信息，并附加声明。
越方出口前按每批2%抽样检查（一年内无问题降为1%）。
records.sourceLabel: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM), republishing GACC
records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2025年第71号
records.sourceLabelZh: 商务部网站转载海关总署公告

records.title: GACC 2022 No. 117
records.scope: Fresh sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas) not for planting, grown anywhere in Vietnam, is permitted under GACC Announcement 2022 No. 117.
records.scopeZh: 越南全境生产的不作种植用途的新鲜甘薯（Ipomoea batatas）依据海关总署公告2022年第117号获准进口。
conditions: Plantations and processing plants must be registered with Vietnam and listed by GACC.
Remove damaged roots, wash twice and remove soil; Vietnam samples at least 2% of each lot and cuts at least 60 roots.
Phytosanitary certificate must show plantation/processor, container and seal numbers.
Importer needs an import quarantine permit; entry only via ports with a designated imported-grain supervision site.
conditionsZh: 种植基地和加工厂须经越方注册并由海关总署公布。
剔除病残薯，清水冲洗两次并去除土壤；越方每批抽样不低于2%，剖检不少于60个甘薯。
植物检疫证书须注明种植基地/加工厂、集装箱号和封识号。
进口商须办理进境动植物检疫许可证；须从具备进境粮食指定监管场地的口岸进境。
records.sourceLabel: Fujian Provincial Department of Commerce, republishing GACC
records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2022年第117号
records.sourceLabelZh: 福建省商务厅网站转载海关总署公告

records.title: GACC 2026 No. 140
records.scope: Fresh sweet cherry (Prunus avium) from South African cherry production areas is permitted under GACC Announcement 2026 No. 140.
records.scopeZh: 南非樱桃产区的鲜食欧洲甜樱桃（Prunus avium）依据海关总署公告2026年第140号获准进口。
conditions: Orchards, packing houses and treatment facilities must be audited by South Africa and registered jointly by both sides.
Cold treatment (e.g. 1.11°C or below for 14 days) or methyl bromide fumigation under official supervision.
Cartons and pallets marked with origin, registration numbers and export-to-China wording.
Phytosanitary certificate with treatment details and additional declaration; 2% pre-export sampling.
conditionsZh: 果园、包装厂和处理设施须经南非方审核，并由中方和南非方共同批准注册。
须在官方监管下实施冷处理（如1.11℃或以下持续14天）或溴甲烷熏蒸。
包装箱和托盘须标注产地、注册号及“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须注明处理信息并附加声明；出口前按2%抽样检查。
records.sourceLabel: MOFCOM Global Law database (policy.mofcom.gov.cn), republishing GACC
records.titleZh: 海关总署公告2026年第140号
records.sourceLabelZh: 商务部全球法规网转载海关总署公告

records.title: GACC 2024 No. 134
records.scope: Edible chilli fruit (Capsicum spp.) grown and processed in Tanzania, including fresh chilli, is permitted under GACC Announcement 2024 No. 134.
records.scopeZh: 在坦桑尼亚境内种植和加工的食用辣椒果实（Capsicum spp.，含新鲜辣椒）依据海关总署公告2024年第134号获准进口。
conditions: Growing bases and packing houses must be audited by Tanzania and registered by GACC.
Fresh chilli requires methyl bromide fumigation followed by cold treatment.
Cartons and pallets marked with origin, registration details and export-to-China wording.
Phytosanitary certificate with additional declaration; 2% pre-export sampling (1% after one clean year).
conditionsZh: 种植基地和包装厂须经坦方审核并由海关总署注册。
新鲜辣椒须先行溴甲烷熏蒸，再实施冷处理。
包装箱和托盘须标注产地、注册信息及“输往中华人民共和国”。
植物检疫证书须附加声明；出口前按2%抽样（一年无问题降为1%）。
